title: Manual for the General Court of New Hampshire 1949, general election returns, summary by counties (general election 1948-11-02)

offices.president: Electors of President and Vice-President: one column per ticket (printed as the presidential and vice-presidential candidates, for example "Dewey and Warren, r"); name is the presidential candidate's surname; only the 1948 general election summary by counties (ten county rows and a totals row); skip checklist, ballots cast, absentee, state stores, and beverages tables
offices.governor: Governor; only the 1948 general election summary by counties (ten county rows and a totals row); skip checklist, ballots cast, absentee, state stores, and beverages tables
offices.senate: U.S. Senator, not a state senator; only the 1948 general election summary by counties (ten county rows and a totals row); skip checklist, ballots cast, absentee, state stores, and beverages tables

note: Leaves are Internet Archive page indexes (printed page 552).
